content:
elijah: Heads-up — in the compact modal view the sticky table header overlaps the primary footer CTA when you collapse the window width. See repro GIF: https://img.redwood/shots/1290 :eyes:

tanya: saw that too on mobile breakpoint (<=420px). The header has position: sticky with top: 0 but the modal footer is positioned fixed at the bottom of the modal, so they collide when table height is small.

rachel: UX implication: users can't see the CTA label sometimes because header shadow covers the button, looks like a bug. Also noticed primary CTA hit target is effectively 28px tall in dense rows which fails our touch target guidelines (44px).

design-bot: Recommendation: spacing token set has token spacing-touch-min = 44px; use that for primary actions in compact overlays. Also consider a token for sticky offsets (token: sticky-header-offset) so header can respect footer height.

elijah: quick CSS patch suggestion I tried: ```css
.modal .table thead { position: sticky; top: var(--sticky-header-offset, 56px); z-index: 6; }
.modal .footer { position: absolute; bottom: 0; height: var(--footer-height, 56px); }
```
worked locally but felt hacky.

tanya: Agree. We shouldn't hardcode pixels. Let's introduce two tokens: --footer-height-compact and --sticky-header-offset that defaults to footer height plus 8px. That keeps spacing system-driven.

rachel: On hit targets: can we create a modifier class .btn--touch that applies min-height: var(--spacing-touch-min); padding adjustments so visual size doesn't balloon but touch target increases? We use similar pattern in mobile toolbar.

dev-bot: Note from runtime: there is an existing breakpoint token named bp-compact that many components already reference. Any new tokens should map to existing breakpoints to avoid duplication. Also raising z-index for header will influence toasts; previously toasts were above everything which caused them to obscure header.

elijah: Speaking of toasts, when a toast appears at the top it pushes the sticky header down and then the footer and header end up overlapping briefly. Proposed rule: toasts should be positioned outside the modal stacking context (portal) and use a toast-stack container that does not reflow modal contents.

tanya: +1. Also add aria-live="polite" for non-critical toasts and ensure screen readers announce them without shifting layout. For critical errors use assertive.

rachel: I'm worried about visual noise if we increase footer height across the board. Suggest doing token override only inside .modal--compact. We can create a variant token mapping e.g., --footer-height: var(--footer-height-compact) when .modal--compact is present.

elijah: Implementation plan:
- rachel: create design PR with token names and screenshots for compact modal states.
- tanya: update CSS to respect token-based offsets and add .btn--touch spec.
- dev-bot: devs to portal toasts and ensure z-index tokens exist (toast-z, header-z, footer-z).

design-bot: Accessibility checklist for this change: ensure focus order not changed by portaled toasts; ensure keyboard and screen reader access to primary CTA; test VoiceOver rotor and TalkBack focus order; verify hit target sizes with touch simulator.

elijah: I'll open GH issue with repro assets and suggested tokens: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/issues/4310. Adding a small recording and the CSS snippet.

rachel: I'll draft the visual spec and example tokens in Figma, mark as review-needed.

tanya: I'll prototype CSS and link a tiny demo in the PR so QA can validate on device.

elijah: Thanks all. Marking this P2 but aiming for fix in next minor UI patch. :rocket:
